description: Local persistence: add the single new runtime dependency (@react-native-async-storage/async-storage pinned 2.2.0), create src/persistence/store.ts (the ONLY AsyncStorage consumer) with safe-across-reopen loads, honest save failures, and a full-clear deletion contract, and test it against the official AsyncStorage jest mock. Depends on FEAT-002 (it stores/restores the ProgressionState shape and uses emptyProgression()). Design sections 2 and 7. Carries the REQUIRED local-data-deletion-clearing-state test.
steps: Add '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage': '2.2.0' (NO caret) to dependencies in /Users/Shared/goalie/package.json, matching node_modules/expo/bundledNativeModules.json. Run npm install to resolve and update package-lock.json. This is the ONLY new runtime dependency this phase.

Create /Users/Shared/goalie/src/persistence/store.ts per design 7.1-7.3: the only module importing AsyncStorage. Export STORAGE_KEY='goalie.v1'; PersistedData{version:1, selectedTrackId:string|null, displayName:string|null, progression:ProgressionState}; defaultPersistedData() = {version:1,null,null,emptyProgression()}; async loadData(), saveData(data), clearData(). loadData reads STORAGE_KEY: absent -> defaultPersistedData(); unparseable (JSON.parse throws) OR shape-invalid -> treat as corrupt, return defaultPersistedData() + a single console.warn('goalie: discarding unreadable store'); a native read rejection propagates as a rejected promise (root gate handles it). The structural guard (design 7.2) checks: outer PersistedData.version===1 AND inner progression.version===1; progression.levels is a plain object (not null, not array); every value in levels is an object with completedLessonIds an array whose every element is a non-empty string, masteryPassed a boolean, and bestCorrectCount an integer in [0,5]. saveData writes JSON.stringify under STORAGE_KEY; on write rejection propagate (warn) and keep in-memory state (never silently claim success). clearData calls AsyncStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY).

Create /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/store.test.ts using the official mock: jest.mock('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage', () => require('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage/jest/async-storage-mock')). Cover (design 7.4): load-absent -> defaults; load-corrupt (bad JSON) -> defaults + one warn; stored bestCorrectCount:999 -> defaults + warn; stored completedLessonIds:[null] -> defaults + warn; save -> load round-trip preserves data; clear -> load returns defaultPersistedData() (LOCAL-DATA DELETION CLEARS STATE); reopen (fresh loadData after save then clear) confirms nothing persisted. Spy on console.warn to assert the single warning where specified.
acceptance_criteria: package.json lists @react-native-async-storage/async-storage at exactly 2.2.0 (no caret) and npm install updated package-lock.json consistently.
src/persistence/store.ts is the only file importing AsyncStorage and exposes STORAGE_KEY, PersistedData, defaultPersistedData, loadData, saveData, clearData.
npx jest __tests__/store.test.ts passes, including the clear->empty deletion test and the corrupt/out-of-range -> defaults+warn cases.
npm run typecheck passes (strict) with the persistence module.
A corrupt or out-of-range store never surfaces dishonest values to callers (guard returns defaults).
findings:
Local persistence implemented and green. @react-native-async-storage/async-storage pinned EXACTLY to 2.2.0 (no caret) in package.json dependencies; npm install resolved it (added 3 packages) and updated package-lock.json; installed version confirmed 2.2.0; official jest mock present at node_modules/@react-native-async-storage/async-storage/jest/async-storage-mock.js.

src/persistence/store.ts is the ONLY module importing AsyncStorage (grep-confirmed). Exact store API the UI context (FEAT-004) calls:
- export const STORAGE_KEY = 'goalie.v1';
- export interface PersistedData { version: 1; selectedTrackId: string | null; displayName: string | null; progression: ProgressionState }  (ProgressionState imported from src/domain/progression; stored verbatim).
- export function defaultPersistedData(): PersistedData  => { version:1, selectedTrackId:null, displayName:null, progression: emptyProgression() }.
- export async function loadData(): Promise<PersistedData>  — reads STORAGE_KEY: absent -> defaultPersistedData(); JSON.parse throws OR structural guard fails -> defaultPersistedData() + a single console.warn('goalie: discarding unreadable store'); a native getItem rejection PROPAGATES (root gate handles it).
- export async function saveData(data: PersistedData): Promise<void>  — writes JSON.stringify(data) under STORAGE_KEY; on setItem rejection logs console.warn('goalie: failed to save store') and RE-THROWS (never a false success; caller keeps in-memory state).
- export async function clearData(): Promise<void>  — AsyncStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); single-key design wipes all Goalie state at once.

Structural guard (design 7.2, lightweight — not the catalog parser): outer version===1; selectedTrackId/displayName each string|null; progression is a plain object with version===1 and levels a plain object (not null, not array); every level value is a plain object with completedLessonIds an array of non-empty strings, masteryPassed a boolean, and bestCorrectCount an integer in [0,5]. Any predicate failure -> corrupt -> defaults + one warn.

__tests__/store.test.ts registers jest.mock('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage', () => require('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage/jest/async-storage-mock')) and covers: load-absent->defaults; load-corrupt(bad JSON)->defaults+one warn; bestCorrectCount:999->defaults+one warn; completedLessonIds:[null]->defaults+one warn; save->load round-trip preserves data (no warn); clear->loadData returns defaultPersistedData() (REQUIRED local-data-deletion test); reopen (save then clear) confirms the key is null and loadData returns defaults.

Verification (from /Users/Shared/goalie): `npm install` exit 0 (async-storage@2.2.0, package-lock.json updated); `npm run typecheck` clean (strict); `npx jest __tests__/store.test.ts` => Test Suites: 1 passed; Tests: 7 passed. eslint on the two files: 0 errors (1 warning is the mandated require()-in-jest.mock official-mock pattern).
